name: the X row is dropped from LINK_OWNERS: an X post/profile link reaches the provider instead of x_read
old:
LinkOwner(
        network="x", tool="x_read", param="link",
        label="an X link", claim=_x_claim,
    ),

name: the LinkedIn row is dropped from LINK_OWNERS: a LinkedIn person/company link reaches the provider instead of linkedin_read
old:
LinkOwner(
        network="linkedin", tool="linkedin_read", param="link",
        label="a LinkedIn link", claim=_linkedin_claim,
    ),

name: _x_claim is widened to also claim X's own shortener (t.co) and CDN (twimg.com) hosts
_linkedin_claim is widened to also claim LinkedIn's own shortener (lnkd.in) and CDN (licdn.com) hosts
_linkedin_claim's post exclusion is dropped: a LinkedIn post link is claimed and redirected instead of left for web_fetch/media_fetch
_linkedin_claim's m.linkedin.com fallback is dropped: a mobile LinkedIn link is unclaimed instead of redirected with the www-link note
